newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.

text.p: Robert Fleming & Co Ltd reiterated its buy rating on Brazilian telecom holding Telebras after the government announced its privatization schedule for the firm.
-- Flemings analysts William Laurent and Ronald Aitken cited Communications Minister Sergio Motta's announcement Tuesday that the government would try to privatize the entire firm by mid-1998.
-- The government had earlier said it would complete Telebras' privatization by the end of 1998.
-- The minister's statement "provides yet another piece of good news for Telebras shareholders,' the analysts wrote in a report.
-- Motta's announcement that the government does not favor the complete spin-off of the cellular divisions of Telebras, known as A Band, also is favorable to stockholders, they added.
-- "At $140 per ADR, Telebras is the third cheapest telco in emerging markets despite significantly better growth and news flow prospects," they said.
-- Telebras' ADR was up 1/8 at 143-7/8 in New York, while in Sao Paulo.
